scene.name: Chapter 03 - Collision
scene.story_beat: Kaeldor and the schoolboys accidentally knock Tsaeytte over, spilling her and her books to the ground.

style.art_style: Painterly semi-realistic fantasy illustration with anime-influenced facial proportions, large expressive eyes, refined linework, and warm storybook-fantasy color handling.

rules: Preserve the story's canonical art style across all scene images.
Preserve recurring characters, costumes, props, and locations when referenced by scene tags.

environment.location: On the pathway in front of the arch.
environment.general_foreground_notes: Books are scattered on the pathway.

elements.element_visual_override: Knocked over, sitting on the ground. Tear welling up.

resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_core: Tsaeytte — Petite adolescent high elf with a slender, lightly athletic build and youthful features. Short tousled black bob framing both cheeks, with a woodland-green ribbon tied at the back. Large expressive violet eyes, fair skin, pointed elf ears. She is innocent, thoughtful, and quietly determined, with a subtle sense of wonder.
resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_costume: Tsaeytte Costume — Simple, practical village clothing consisting of a light leaf-green long-sleeved blouse tucked into a plain dark forest-green ankle-length wool skirt with a broad brown leather belt. Thick cream socks and sturdy brown lace-up leather boots. Clothing is modest, durable, and unadorned, reflecting a rural upbringing with no jewelry, weapons, or signs of wealth.

resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_core: Valindia Vandermere — Tall, elegant half-elf young woman with a confident, aristocratic bearing. Sharp jaw-length bob haircut with vivid crimson-red outer hair over black underlayers, straight with blunt ends. Fair skin, narrow violet eyes, refined features, pointed elf ears. Poised, immaculately groomed, fashionable, and subtly condescending.
resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_costume: Valindia Costume — Tailored black academy attire with ornate gold embroidery, high standing collar, fitted jacket, matching short overskirt with decorative trim, black stockings, and black heeled ankle boots. Gold-and-red gemstone earrings and matching pendant necklace. Worn with immaculate precision and noble elegance, emphasizing wealth, status, and impeccable taste.

elements.element_visual_override: Kaeldor is walking out of frame toward the camera. He slightly turns his head to speak to Tsaeytte.

resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_core: Kaeldor — Tall, athletic young high elf with an effortlessly handsome, confident presence. Short tousled sandy-blond hair with shaved sides featuring a distinctive geometric undercut pattern. Warm tan complexion, amber-brown eyes, strong jawline, pointed elf ears, and a relaxed, cocky grin. Carries himself with easy charisma, wealth, and the self-assurance of someone accustomed to getting his way.
resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_costume: Kaeldor Costume — Fashionably disheveled academy uniform worn in deliberate violation of dress code. White dress shirt partly unbuttoned with sleeves casually rolled to the forearms beneath an open burgundy vest trimmed in gold and bearing the academy crest. Dark tailored plaid trousers with belt and decorative pocket chain, polished black shoes, and a distinctive blue gemstone family amulet worn openly at the chest. Everything is expensive, impeccably tailored, and intentionally styled to look effortlessly rebellious.

elements.element_visual_override: The schoolboys are walking out of frame with Kaeldor.

resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_core: Two boisterous fashionable late-teen students laughing, joking, and moving together with casual confidence. Attractive, athletic, and carefree, they project popularity, entitlement, and youthful arrogance. Their behavior is loud and energetic rather than malicious, more thoughtless than cruel.
resolved_source_sections.identity_preservation_costume: Schoolboy Uniforms — Variations of the Spire academy uniform featuring tailored burgundy jackets or open vests with gold trim and academy crests, white dress shirts (often unbuttoned at the collar or with rolled sleeves), dark tailored trousers, leather belts, and polished boots or shoes. Each student wears the uniform with individual flair while remaining recognizably part of the academy.

pose.summary: Sitting on the ground amongst scattered books. Legs out front, hands behind to support her.

placements.placement_notes: We see Tsaeytte from her front-left 3/4.

pose.summary: Valindia is under the arch, she has turned to face Tsaeytte, she is raising her hands to her face in concern.

motion.cue: Kaeldor and the schoolboys are pushing and pulling each other.
They are pushing and pulling each other.

dialogue.notes: Kaeldor has only slightly turned his head.

final_image_prompt_sections.anatomical_requirements:
# Anatomical Requirements

Render anatomically correct characters.

- Every visible hand has exactly five fingers in the correct anatomical arrangement.
- Hands, wrists, elbows, shoulders, legs, feet, necks, and torsos are naturally connected.
- No extra limbs, missing limbs, fused limbs, duplicated body parts, or disconnected anatomy.
- Fingers have natural proportions and believable poses.
- Character interactions do not cause anatomy to intersect or merge.
final_image_prompt_sections.avoid:
# Avoid

- Inconsistent character identity.
- Wrong costume.
- Modern objects.
- Unreadable faces.
- Merged characters.
- Cropped characters.
- Anatomical distortions.
final_image_prompt_sections.high_risk_elements:
# High-Risk Elements

Pay particular attention to:

- Hands making gestures.
- Characters sitting with crossed legs.
- Characters touching or closely facing each other.
- Objects held in the hands.
- Long ears remaining fully attached and correctly shaped.
- Hair remaining consistent with the reference.
final_image_prompt_sections.final_verification:
# Final Verification

Before producing the final image, verify that:

- Character count and identities exactly match the scene description.
- Every character is in the correct left/right position and depth.
- Every visible hand has exactly five fingers with correct anatomy.
- Arms, legs, feet, ears, and clothing are fully connected and anatomically correct.
- Characters are completely separate; no merged bodies or intersecting limbs.
- Props are held naturally and are clearly readable.
- Eye lines and interactions match the story beat.
- Costumes and recurring character features match the supplied references.
- The setting, lighting, mood, and art style match the scene specification.
